title: A cloud page whose sign-in ends after a log-off in another tab says only 'Not synced yet.'
evidence: The save alert is one state, saveAlert (widget-src/standalone/sync-control.tsx). A cloud page whose writes stopped after another tab's log-off says, once a save fails, 'This browser was logged off in another tab. Your latest changes show here but are not saved.' It asks for no reload, since a reload loses what is on the page (US-09 AC60; words Brad 2026-11-26).
